name: Flowspace
long_description:
Flowspace is a modern fulfillment provider that combines powerful technology with expert fulfillment operations to deliver seamless and scalable execution that moves with your business.

Purpose-built for ecommerce and omnichannel fulfillment, Flowspace unifies order management (OMS), inventory management (IMS), network optimization, seamless integrations, EDI, and proprietary warehouse management (WMS) technology. With negotiated carrier rates, automated B2B packing, D2C kitting and bundling, and a self-service AI tool, Flowspace provides the flexibility and control modern brands need to operate efficiently at scale without adding operational headcount.
one_liner: The operating system powering ecommerce fulfillment
